g.text: PROPOSED PIN MAP - reviewed against manufacturer drawings; not yet tested on this Heltec.
All GND symbols join the same ground. R1 goes from SD to GND, not in series with GPIO48.
Leave the GNSS/GPS socket and expansion/touch accessories disconnected (GPIO38/39 are reused).
USB-powered bench only. Attach the correct antenna to LoRa ANT before power. See pin locator on sheet 2.
